The picture taken by Mica Hammel in 2019, shows volunteers collecting rubbish at the beach.
The picture “Teamwork”, taken by Lovisa Trent in 2024, illustrates the importance of cooperation by showing several stacked hands.

elements: In the background, there is a family during a festive dinner, possibly on Christmas Eve.
The picture was taken from the perspective of a child looking up to the grown-ups.
This picture was taken by Robert Murphy in 1995.
The picture is meant to highlight the sensitivity of children and their striving for belonging.
